title: Replace first dashboard summary card with Monthly Target aggregate

requirements.text: In the top-row dashboard summary cards (frontend/src/components/Dashboard.tsx), replace the first card currently titled "Total Goals" with a new summary card titled "Monthly Target" without removing the existing 5-card grid layout or changing any existing goal data.

quotes: Replace 'Total Goals' card (1st card) with a new card titled 'Monthly Target'.
Do NOT delete any existing layout or goal data. Just update the 1st card and its calculation logic.

acceptanceCriteria: When goals.length > 0, the top row still renders 5 cards in the same grid, but the first card’s label reads "Monthly Target" instead of "Total Goals".
No other summary cards (Total Target, Total Saved, Next Deadline, Emergency Fund) are removed or rearranged.

requirements.text: Compute the "Monthly Target" summary value as the automated sum of the per-goal Monthly Target amounts shown in the individual goal cards, using the same monthly-target calculation rules as GoalCard (including deadline-based monthsRemaining logic and the <1 month remaining correction). Only include goals that currently display a Monthly Target row (i.e., goals with a deadline where the monthly target row is rendered); treat goals that do not show a Monthly Target row as contributing 0 to the sum.

quotes: The value must be the automated sum of all 'Monthly Target' amounts from the individual goal cards below.

The 'Monthly Target' fields already exist inside each individual goal card (e.g., '€110.00/month'). You need to extract these values from the existing goal cards and sum them up for the new 'Monthly Target' summary card.

acceptanceCriteria: For a set of goals, the value shown in the new "Monthly Target" summary card equals the sum of the Monthly Target values that appear on those goals’ cards.
The summary uses the same global currency symbol logic as the other dashboard totals (EUR -> €; USD -> $).
The summed value is formatted to 2 decimal places (to match goal-card monthly target formatting).

requirements.text: Match styling and alignment of the new "Monthly Target" summary card to the existing dashboard card template: (1) place a Calendar or Repeat icon on the LEFT inside a 10x10 rounded icon wrapper, consistent with other cards; (2) color both the icon and the main amount text using the exact same blue color used by the goal cards’ Monthly Target value (use the existing `text-monthly-target` styling); (3) keep the card title in the default dark/grey style used by other card titles; (4) ensure the amount baseline aligns with the other top-row cards (no vertical misalignment vs Total Target/Total Saved).

quotes: Icon Placement (Crucial): Place a 'Calendar' or 'Repeat' icon on the LEFT side, matching the position and style of the icons in the other cards (like the crosshair in Total Target).
Use the exact same blue color for the amount text and the icon as is currently used for the 'Monthly Target' labels in the goals below.
The card title 'Monthly Target' stays in the default dark/grey style.
Alignment Fix: Ensure the baseline of the new blue amount aligns perfectly with the other cards, following our 'green line' rule.

acceptanceCriteria: The new card’s internal structure matches the other summary cards’ structure: icon wrapper on the left + a text block with a small label and a large amount beneath it.
The icon uses the same left placement, size, and wrapper styling pattern as the other summary cards (w-10 h-10 rounded-lg + existing icon background utility class).
The amount text and the icon inherit the same blue as GoalCard’s Monthly Target value (via the `text-monthly-target` class) in both light and dark themes.
Visually, the large amount’s baseline aligns with the large amounts in the neighboring summary cards (no extra padding/margin causing the number to sit higher/lower).

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be modified: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui/*.
Do not delete or reset any existing goals, emergency fund data, or overall dashboard layout; only replace the first summary card and add the required aggregate calculation.
nonGoals: Do not change backend data models or Motoko APIs for this task.
Do not redesign the other summary cards, goal cards, or overall dashboard layout beyond what is necessary to replace the first card.
Do not change the per-goal Monthly Target formula behavior in GoalCard; the dashboard should match it.
